The game is fun until it's not. It's the classic match-3 without ads, but with one huge caveat: around level 900 or so you will be met with a pay wall. You'll be cruising on free gold and power ups forever, feel like a gummi god, and then suddenly you're out of gold because the levels are designed to force you to pony up the free stuff - fast - until there's no option but to pay to beat a single level. You will be forced to use up everything before you know it. Don't bother. Watch ads elsewhere.

Fine game, no ads unless you accidentally hit the ad button - giving it 4 stars bc I came upon a level that is impossible to complete without gold (3799). I'm sure there's levels earlier than that that are exactly the same, but that was the first that I took the time to test out if it was possible to win under the best luck, but 19 moves is not enough to get the keys when they only appear every three moves when 7 keys are needed.

Sugar Crush is a fun and enjoyable match-3 puzzle game with colorful graphics, simple controls, and many challenging levels that keep players entertained. The gameplay is easy to learn but becomes more difficult as you progress, making it interesting for both new and experienced players. However, some levels can feel repetitive, and waiting for lives or relying on boosters may interrupt the experience. Overall, Sugar Crush is a good casual game for passing the time.
